interpretation.cash_and_risk: Trend and scaling materially change market exposure; drawdown/tail reductions cannot be called timing alpha without exposure/factor identification.
interpretation.concentration: Instrument and positive-day PnL concentration is descriptive; individual FIFO round-trip concentration was not independently reconstructed.
interpretation.evidence_limit: No winner chosen after results; no investment profitability or live-execution claim.
interpretation.formal_family_placeholders: p=1 values are NOT_READY placeholders, not completed tests or adjusted evidence.
interpretation.validation_absolute_performance: All eight 100k/base accounts lose money; absolute loss does not logically negate positive relative paired increments.
interpretation.validation_scaled_R1_rank: Positive exploratory zero-fixed-cost relative evidence, including all three block intervals; corresponding development mean is negative. Not ignored, not confirmed.
interpretation.year_deletion: Both candidate-best compounded year return and maximum paired annual CNY PnL contribution rules are reported symmetrically, with identical dates removed. No new p-values.

Daily OHLC cannot establish intraday queue, 09:35-10:00 prices or executable liquidity; historical ADV1% is a model.

Six retired candidates include five liquidations and one ETF-to-mixed-fund conversion; none selected/held. Conversion rights execution unsupported in this run scope.

R1I and other research families not evaluated; no factor-alpha estimate.
Unknown incremental fixed costs and unfrozen final primary candidate block economic confirmation.
Marginal bootstrap/HAC diagnostics assume approximate dependence regularity; all paths/overlapping windows are dependent observations.
